purpose: Form NDH-1 is used by a Nidhi to file a return of statutory compliances regarding its members, Net Owned Funds, term deposits, and deposit ratio.
when: Within ninety days from the close of the first financial year after its incorporation and where applicable, the second financial year
steps: Ensure the Nidhi meets the requirements for minimum members, net owned funds, unencumbered term deposits, and deposit ratio within one year from incorporation.
Get the return of statutory compliances certified by a company secretary in practice, a chartered accountant in practice, or a cost accountant in practice.
File Form NDH-1 with the Registrar along with the required fee within ninety days from the close of the first financial year after incorporation and where applicable, the second financial year.
checklist: Check that the Nidhi has not less than two hundred members.
Check that Net Owned Funds are ten lakh rupees or more.
Check that unencumbered term deposits are not less than ten per cent of outstanding deposits.
Check that the ratio of Net Owned Funds to deposits is not more than 1:20.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
